# NowFocus (full text summary)

Source: https://nowfocus.online/ · Last updated 2026-10-02 · Contact: safwat.rashwan@gmail.com

NowFocus is a deep-work app for Android, macOS and Windows. Start a session and the apps and sites you chose go dark until the timer ends. It runs on your device, so what you block and what you try to open never reaches NowFocus. The apps have no account, no ads, no trackers and no analytics.

## How a session works
1. Start a session: pick a Focus Profile (the apps and sites to block) and a length.
2. Distractions go dark: blocked apps are covered by a full-screen message; blocked sites won't load. On Android the message is "This can wait." with a one-tap call or text to someone who matters.
3. Leaving costs something. Exit modes: Normal (end any time), Strict (type a short sentence, then wait 30 seconds), Locked (no early exit until the timer ends).

## What makes it different
- Friction, not willpower. In Strict mode on Android you also must hear a 10-second voice note you recorded to yourself before leaving.
- Blocks the feed, not the app (Android, experimental): hides YouTube Shorts, Home feed and Up next, and Facebook Reels, while the rest of the app works.
- Private by design: stats are counted on the device, blocking never waits on a server, it works offline.
- 14-day Commitment Shield with a 60-second undo window (typical focus apps: switch off whenever).
- Bedtime Wind-Down, weekly stats, and "reach out to someone instead" (up to five people, one-tap call/text on Android).

## Platform status
- Android: early access v0.3, Android 8.0+. Not on Google Play yet. Most complete. Website blocking at DNS level through an on-device VPN (DNS only); app blocking through an Accessibility service, which also reads the browser address bar only to count time for website daily limits (only minutes on limited sites are kept). Microphone only when recording a voice note. No contacts, phone or SMS permission.
- macOS: early build, macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel. Not yet released or notarized. Menu-bar app. Website blocking through the hosts file; full-screen overlay for apps.
- Windows: in development, Windows 10/11 64-bit. No installer yet. Tray app plus background service; hosts-file blocking.
- iOS: planned, no build, no date. Linux may follow.
- Cross-device sync: not available on any platform yet; each device is independent.

## Pricing
Free. Nothing is locked behind payment today. Paid plans may come later and the site will say so first.

## Privacy summary
Profiles, sessions, stats, goals, contacts you add and voice notes stay on the device. The apps connect to no NowFocus server. On Android, unblocked DNS lookups pass to your network's DNS server (or Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 if it doesn't answer); Google device backup may copy app data to your own Google account (voice notes are excluded). Not directed at children under 13. The website uses Google Analytics 4 with consent: cookies only if you accept, basic cookieless pings otherwise; no Google signals or ads personalisation. Details: https://nowfocus.online/privacy/

## Limits
It is a self-control tool, not a lock. Someone who owns the device can uninstall it or switch off its permissions.
